name: Mondelez International

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (Mondelez International.svg); the Wikipedia infobox logo field is currently commented out, so the Commons wordmark was used

description: Mondelez makes snacks: biscuits and baked snacks (Oreo, Ritz, LU, Clif Bar, Tate's) and chocolate (Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, Toblerone), plus gum, candy and powdered drinks. About 76 percent of revenue is earned outside the US and Europe is the largest region at 39 percent. Money comes from selling branded packaged snacks through retailers worldwide at rising prices, funded by heavy cocoa, sugar, wheat and dairy commodity costs, which it hedges with derivatives. The 2025 headline operating income fell 44 percent to $3.5B mainly because of $1.3B of mark-to-market losses on those hedges; adjusted operating income fell 14 percent.

employees.note: About 91,000 employees: about 12,000 US, about 79,000 outside the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: Snacks sold to grocery and convenience retailers; chocolate is the biggest category here ($7,799M of the region's revenue).
businessLines.description: Snacks sold in Europe; largest region.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; FY2024 $2,068M; before mark-to-market derivative losses, corporate expenses and amortization

businessLines.name: North America
businessLines.how: Branded biscuits, baked snacks and some candy sold to US grocery, club and convenience chains; 2025 revenue fell 2.1% and segment profit fell 23.6%.
businessLines.description: US and Canada snacks; biscuits and baked snacks are nearly all of it.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; FY2024 $2,492M; before mark-to-market derivative losses, corporate expenses and amortization

businessLines.name: AMEA (Asia, Middle East and Africa)
businessLines.how: Sold through distributors and retailers; revenue +8.7%, segment profit -17.4%.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; FY2024 $1,192M; before mark-to-market derivative losses, corporate expenses and amortization

businessLines.name: Latin America
businessLines.how: Branded snacks and gum through retailers and distributors; net pricing +7.8 points offset currency (-5.1 pts) and volume/mix (-3.2 pts).
businessLines.description: Snacks, gum and candy in Latin America.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; FY2024 $532M; before mark-to-market derivative losses, corporate expenses and amortization

brands.name: Biscoff co-branded chocolate (innovation launched with Cadbury Dairy Milk and Milka in Europe)
